targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP 200 CAST(ts AS datetime2) AS ts, source, COALESCE(NULLIF(module_type, N''), CASE module_serial WHEN N'SVR4H73275' THEN N'DPS' WHEN N'SVR3QA0022' THEN N'HBW' WHEN N'SVR4H76449' THEN N'DRILL' WHEN N'SVR3QA2098' THEN N'MILL' WHEN N'SVR4H76530' THEN N'AIQS' ELSE NULL END) AS module_type, module_serial, action_state, event_type, topic FROM shopfloor_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (topic LIKE N'module/v1/ff/%' OR topic LIKE N'fts/v1/ff/%') ORDER BY ts DESC
